description: Detects the intersection point (corner) of two dominant lines in a binary image, each selected from a specified image edge (top, bottom, left, right). Uses Hough-based line detection with adjustable search accuracy. Returns subpixel-accurate corner coordinates and quality scores.

quality_score.line1: Number of detected line segments for line 1
quality_score.line2: Number of detected line segments for line 2

params.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate this function.
Edge of the image (top, bottom, left, right) from which to detect the first line.
Minimum length (in microns) of segments for the first line detection.
Edge of the image (top, bottom, left, right) from which to detect the second line.
Minimum length (in microns) of segments for the second line detection.

Controls the accuracy of the HoughLinesP search. 'coarse': rho_adaptive=1.0, theta_adaptive=180; 'fine': rho_adaptive=0.5, theta_adaptive=1800; 'finest': rho_adaptive=0.5, theta_adaptive=3600; 'max_limit': rho_adaptive=0.5, theta_adaptive=16400.
Sets the maximum perpendicular distance (in pixels) from the initial line segment within which edge points are considered inliers for line refinement.
Minimum number of inliers required for a valid line fit.
